field_reference.rank: Position in power_rankings, 1 for the highest power_score. Companies whose collection failed are ranked after every collected company.
field_reference.ticker: Exchange ticker, or null for the roster's private companies.
field_reference.company_name: Company name as it appears on the conference roster.
field_reference.market_cap_usd: Market capitalisation in US dollars from the roster, or null where there is none to state. Not collected, not scored.
field_reference.cap_band: Roster's market-capitalisation band. Not collected, not scored.
field_reference.listing: Roster's listing status. Not collected, not scored.
field_reference.total_mentions: Conference-wide sum of mention_volume over the successfully collected companies.
field_reference.companies_with_conversation: Successfully collected companies with at least one matching post.
field_reference.companies_silent: Successfully collected companies with no matching posts. A measured zero, counted separately from companies_failed.
field_reference.power_score: 0-100 composite. Sum of weighted_components. Weights are published in run.weights.
field_reference.mention_volume: Posts matching the company name in the window, across the searched platforms.
field_reference.total_engagement: Interactions -- likes, replies, reposts and their equivalents -- across the whole matched population, not only the sampled posts. Under conference, the sum over the successfully collected companies.
field_reference.engagement_rate: total_engagement divided by mention_volume. The numerator covers the full matched population while the denominator counts only the capped post sample, so this is the ratio of those two figures and not a literal average of interactions per post.
field_reference.unique_authors: Distinct accounts among the sampled posts.
field_reference.net_sentiment: Percentage points from -100 to 100: positive posts minus negative posts, over the posts classified positive, negative or neutral.
field_reference.sentiment_counts: Sampled posts by classified sentiment. Posts the classifier judged irrelevant are excluded.
field_reference.normalized_percentile: Per-dimension standing against the rest of the field: the percentage of successfully collected companies whose value this company strictly exceeds. Ties share a rank.
field_reference.weighted_components: Each dimension's normalized_percentile scaled by that dimension's share of the total weight. These sum to power_score.
field_reference.share_of_voice: A company's mention_volume as a percentage of all successfully collected companies' mentions. Scored, so it appears in normalized_percentile and weighted_components rather than in metrics.
field_reference.no_conversation: True when the company was collected successfully and genuinely had no matching posts. A measured zero.
field_reference.collection_failed: True when the search for this company did not complete. Its metrics, percentiles and components are omitted rather than reported as zero, and it is excluded from the ranking and from the conference totals. No value in this file is ever estimated or modelled.
field_reference.companies_failed: Companies whose search did not complete. Counted separately from companies_silent, which are measured zeros.
